CustomField.label: Successor Phone
CustomField.description: Clickable phone link that displays in the highlights panel. When clicked, initiates a phone call to the successor.
CustomField.formula: IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Successor__r.MobilePhone)), HYPERLINK('tel:' & Successor__r.MobilePhone, Successor__r.MobilePhone, '_self'), IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Successor__r.Phone)), HYPERLINK('tel:' & Successor__r.Phone, Successor__r.Phone, '_self'), '' ) )
